verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents an API to retrieve ThumbnailSet resources for a driveItem, and claims rich thumbnails for hundreds of formats. That covers the thumbnail half of the story as an API call without client-side rendering. Nothing in the pack shows an embeddable document-preview endpoint or embed URL. missing for 10: documented embeddable document preview API, specifics on supported formats/sizes, independent or hands-on corroboration of thumbnail quality.
